newsitem.title: UK: Baltic Freight Index slips by eight to 1,434.
newsitem.headline: Baltic Freight Index slips by eight to 1,434.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was down eight points to 1,434 on Tuesday.
Grain trading was generally quiet, apart from further barley shipments to Saudi Arabia.

Dreyfus has booked two Panamax's and Toepfer one Panamax from NOPAC for December loading at between $20 and $20.25, while Glencore fixed a prompt 30,000-tonne barley cargo from Newcastle (U.K.) to Jeddah at $23.75.
